tasks.title: Implement WorkflowEngine with multi-worker execution
tasks.description: Create src/workflow/engine.ts implementing WorkflowEngine class with N workers (configurable via maxConcurrentAgents). Each worker independently polls TaskRepo for pending tasks using findAndClaim atomic operation (single UPDATE with NOT EXISTS subquery in one SQLite transaction, see D12). Execute corresponding StageHandler, handle success/failure. Enforce same-Issue single-task constraint at SQL level. Maintain worktree path registry (Map<issueId, worktreePath>), recover from git worktree list on startup. On task completion, check Issue status is still active before advancing stage. Provide killAgentByIssueId() for pause support.
acceptanceCriteria: Engine starts N workers on start()
findAndClaim uses single SQL with NOT EXISTS to enforce same-Issue constraint atomically
Same-Issue running task prevents new task execution at SQL level (not post-check)
Task success checks Issue is still active before advancing stage
Task failure marks issue as blocked
Worktree path registry maintained and recovered on startup
killAgentByIssueId() terminates running Agent for given Issue
stop() gracefully waits for running tasks with timeout
Build passes without type errors
tasks.notes: findAndClaim SQL (D12): UPDATE tasks SET status='running' WHERE id=(SELECT id FROM tasks t WHERE t.status='pending' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tasks t2 WHERE t2.issue_id=t.issue_id AND t2.status='running') ORDER BY t.started_at LIMIT 1) RETURNING *; Use DatabaseManager.get() not run() since better-sqlite3 get() supports RETURNING rows. Add findAndClaim method to TaskRepo in this task scope. Also add TaskRepo.findRunningByIssue(issueId: string) for killAgentByIssueId reverse lookup (D13). Engine maintains Map<issueId, taskId> — Worker registers on task claim, clears on task complete/fail. killAgentByIssueId flow: lookup taskId from map → TaskRepo.updateStatus(taskId, 'failed', 'user_paused') → AgentRunner.killAgent(taskId) → clear map entry.
